title: Claire Davis - Long Gone
htmlContent:
Claire Davis's music has recently overtaken the globe as she again disclosed another hit single titled "Long Gone." The treasure of Canada's Soul scene takes it up a notch and showcases her mighty vocals on the emotive breakup single "Long Gone." 

"Long Gone" is a song about knowing your worth if you're exploring a relationship that turned your life upside down and learning when to walk away from those who don't. This promising talent has built a trademark of emotive Retro-soul sounds carried by confidential songwriting brimming with her life adventures. Claire Davis has much in store for the coming months.

Claire Davis's "Long Gone" is available on all streaming platforms!
